creative_objective: Make the woman who fears needles and surgery feel the result in one glance: the same 3D character goes from jeans hanging flat at the back to round lifted glutes, holding the real bottle, with a headline that promises a natural daily ritual without needles.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) the 3D before/after, 2) the headline on the dark panel, 3) the big bottle, 4) the starburst and the yellow button, 5) the benefit icons and the 'Pagas al recibir' strip
art_direction.composition_style: Top ribbon, central split before/after with a vertical line and curved arrow, bottom band with diagonal dark panel on the left, bottle in the middle overlapping everything, starburst and button on the right
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: 15 % top, 50 % middle, 35 % bottom; the bottle bridges the middle and bottom zones
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Soft 3D animated-film lighting, warm key light from the upper left, gentle rim light, soft shadows
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: The reference image has a light sky-blue background. Top 15 %: a brand name between two thin lines and a glossy campaign ribbon. Middle 50 %: a 3D animated woman shown twice, split by a thin light vertical line: left with the problem on her body and a scared face, right the same woman smiling and holding the dropper bottle near her shoulder; a curved yellow arrow goes from left to right. Bottom 35 %: on the left a dark diagonal panel with a 3-line italic uppercase headline (last words in yellow), under it a cream card with 4 line icons and short uppercase labels separated by thin lines, and a dark pill with guarantee and shipping; in the center a big dropper bottle standing over everything; on the right a many-pointed starburst with a big discount and a yellow pill button with a round arrow. Our version: no brand logo and no fake campaign; the ribbon carries the product name; the starburst says '1 TOMA AL DÍA' instead of a discount; the dark pill holds the bordered 'Pagas al recibir' badge; the body zone is glutes in jeans, and nothing medical.

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 image ad in a polished 3D animated-feature-film render style (soft subsurface skin, stylized but believable proportions), background very light sky blue (#DDEFFC) with a soft white glow. TOP 15 %: two thin cocoa lines at left and right and, centered, a glossy deep-cocoa (#2B1A10) ribbon banner with rounded ends and a soft glow, with the product name in Poppins ExtraBold italic uppercase, 'VITAL' in white and 'DROPS' in lemon yellow #F5E13A. MIDDLE 50 %: a thin white vertical line splits the scene. LEFT = BEFORE: an adult Colombian woman in her late 20s with adult features, warm tan skin, dark-brown hair in a messy bun, small gold hoop earrings, wearing a plain white t-shirt and light-blue jeans one size too big; she stands three-quarters turned away from the camera, looking back over her shoulder with a worried, frustrated face, camera at hip height; the jeans hang flat at the back with a baggy fold of extra denim under the seat and drooping back pockets, one straight vertical line from waist to thigh, thin straight thighs, and her hand pulls the back waistband about a fist away from her lower back so the empty gap is visible; a dull grey haze sits over the flat seat area. RIGHT = AFTER, another day: the same woman, same face and hair, now in a fitted lemon-yellow t-shirt and dark-blue jeans, three-quarters turned, smiling warmly over her shoulder: an hourglass curvy figure, small waist, hips clearly wider, round full lifted glutes filling the jeans and fuller thighs, obvious at first glance; she holds the product bottle up beside her face with her fingers on the sides, label to camera; her other hand is empty and relaxed. A thick curved lemon-yellow arrow points from the left figure to the right figure across the divider. BOTTOM 35 %: LEFT 48 %, a deep-cocoa diagonal panel rising from left to right holds a 3-line headline in Poppins ExtraBold italic uppercase, the first two lines white and the last line lemon yellow; under it a rounded cream (#FFF6DC) card with 4 thin cocoa line icons (a plate with fork, a lightning bolt, a calm leaf, a dropper) each with 2-3 short uppercase words in Poppins Bold cocoa, separated by thin vertical lines; under the card a deep-cocoa rounded pill containing a bordered badge (2 px white border) with a small hand-and-box icon and white text. CENTER BOTTOM, overlapping the panel and the after figure, the product bottle large, about 45 % of the canvas height, upright, label facing front and fully legible, with a soft shadow; same render quality, the label crisp. RIGHT: a many-pointed lemon-yellow starburst with a thin cocoa outline and big cocoa Poppins ExtraBold text; below it, in the corner, a wide glossy lemon-yellow pill button with cocoa Poppins ExtraBold text and a cocoa circle with a white arrow. PRODUCT: use the attached product photo as the only source of truth: ONE amber-brown glass dropper bottle about 2.6 times taller than wide, Boston-round body with rounded shoulders, ribbed matte black collar about 55 % of the body width, tall matte black rubber dropper bulb, wrap-around label lemon-yellow fading to white with 'amua', the big white outlined word 'VITALDROPS', 'All-In-One Multi-Herbal Supplement', five outlined ingredient circles and 'Dietary Supplement 2 fl. oz. (60mL)'. Not slim, not squat, never mirrored, matte, no rainbow, no lens flare, no yellow '60ml' circle.
